mathematical_scope.input: Finite explicitly encoded free-sign bipartite system; arbitrary rational binary demands and selected integer coordinates; rational binary objective or query.
mathematical_scope.limits: No strongly polynomial overall algorithm, polynomial-size formulation, subtree-hull resolution, production solver, or novelty guarantee.
mathematical_scope.optimization: Exact rational optimum and value, or feasible point with integral improving recession ray, in polynomial bit time.
mathematical_scope.qualifications: Proximity requires mixed feasibility and finite LP optimum; finite threshold ring with base/chain implications; polynomial-bit exact slice oracle; bounded core and explicit per-facet complexity bound.
mathematical_scope.separation: Strong separation and exact membership in the actual closed rational convex hull, including its boundary.
